title: State Advisory Panel
before:
The State Advisory Panel (SAP) advises and works collaboratively with the Office of Special Services and Inclusive Education to provide information, share resources, and identify improvement strategies to help ensure the continued success and improvement of Maine’s comprehensive system of special services.

If you have a question or comment for the SAP to consider, fill out our SAP contact form

decisions.label: Write the email addresses the same way
decisions.why: 1 address is shown in whatever case it was typed in. The house form capitalises each name and leaves a middle initial in lower case — Tracy.W.Whitlock@maine.gov → Tracy.w.Whitlock@maine.gov. Only the first letter of each part changes, so a name that spells itself LaBreck keeps doing so.

decisions.label: Tag a document link with the format it opens
decisions.why: 6 links on this page open a file — 5 PDF, 1 Word — and say nothing about it, while others in the same list carry a tag because their author typed one. The format is read from the file name, so the list stops being half-labelled. No link text changes.

decisions.label: Put the buttons on the house style
decisions.why: 1 button uses a Bootstrap variant rather than btn-info, so the same kind of action is drawn three different ways across the site. Only the class changes.

decisions.label: Use this paragraph as the page description
decisions.why: It is the page’s own opening paragraph, moved into the banner rather than rewritten.
